title: Pressure for the space of average pseudo-orbits with block sub-additive potentials
summary: In this paper, we introduce the concept of block sub-additive potentials and study pressures on spaces of average pseudo-orbits for $\mathbb{Z}_+$-actions generated by continuous surjections on compact metric spaces. Relative to each finite open cover, we define topological and measure-theoretic pressures and establish a local variational principle. We prove that the local topological pressure coincides with the local pressure of the induced sub-additive potential.
